data.gender_notes: Mushahid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who bears witness to the truth or to Allah's greatness. Derived from the Arabic word 'shahida', meaning 'to testify' or 'to bear witness'. The name Mushahid carries the meaning “Witness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mushahid usually hope their child will grow to embody witness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spiritual journey of seeking truth and testifying to Allah's greatness.
data.etymology: Mushahid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Witness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mushahid total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: Mushahid billah ibn Maslama was a prominent Sufi Scholar and poet from the Ghaznavid Empire in the 11th century. He was a disciple of Abdul Qadir Jilani and is known for his poetry and teachings on Sufi mysticism.

Mushahid Qadri was a 16th-century Indian Sufi saint and scholar, who is the founder of the Qadiri-Mashaikh order in India. He is known for his teachings on Sufi mysticism, particularly on the importance of self-surrender to Allah and the role of the spiritual guide in the path of divine realization.
